name: traceframe
description: Animated architecture and system-flow diagrams from a JSON spec: interactive HTML, animated SVG for GitHub READMEs, or MP4/GIF. Imports Mermaid and OpenTelemetry traces. Also an agent skill.

scripts.gallery: node scripts/svg.mjs examples/oauth-pkce.json diagrams/oauth-pkce.svg && node scripts/svg.mjs examples/rag-pipeline.json diagrams/rag-pipeline.svg && node scripts/svg.mjs examples/event-driven-order.json diagrams/event-driven-order.svg && node scripts/svg.mjs examples/incident-response.json diagrams/incident-response.svg
scripts.check: npm test && npm run lint && npm run gallery
